product_overview: NAVPRO is an enterprise platform that digitizes the KKF financial feasibility review process for ICON+/PLN Group, replacing fragmented Excel-based workflows with a centralized, auditable system. It supports project lifecycle management, financial calculations, multi-level approvals, and executive visibility across organizational units.
core_goals: Centralize KKF project creation and lifecycle management in one system
Standardize financial assumptions and calculation rules across all projects
Digitize approval routing with role-based access, SLA tracking, and escalation
Provide immutable audit trails and exportable executive summaries for governance
Improve processing speed, consistency, and transparency for investment decisions

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Allows users to log in, manage their session, view their profile, update their name, and change their password.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/auth/me with JWT token -> Receive 200 with authenticated user profile
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with authentication error
POST /api/v1/auth/login with missing or malformed credentials -> Receive 400 with validation error
POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/v1/auth/logout with JWT token -> Receive 200 confirming logout
GET /api/v1/auth/me without a JWT token -> Receive 401 unauthorized error
PATCH /api/v1/auth/me with JWT token and valid full_name payload -> Receive 200 confirming profile update
PATCH /api/v1/auth/me with JWT token and empty or invalid full_name payload -> Receive 400 validation error
PATCH /api/v1/auth/password with JWT token, correct current_password, and valid new_password -> Receive 200 confirming password update
PATCH /api/v1/auth/password with JWT token and incorrect current_password -> Receive 401 unauthorized error
PATCH /api/v1/auth/password with JWT token and invalid password payload -> Receive 400 validation error
